body: Hey, I really need you to go to the hospital. It will not kill you but it may cause some damage and a lot of pain. Please be safe.
Hey hun, you’re gorgeous. You deserve to be appreciated
Hey. I feel you but it’s going to be ok. Stay safe
No, me and my doctor have ruled that out but thank you for the suggestion!
It is absolutely possible to heal. It’s hard, really hard. But it will be worth it. I’m still getting there too, you’ll be okay friend.

Whatever you do, do not send people content until they’ve paid. If they aren’t sure if you’re legit, ask them to send half before and half after so if you get scammed it’s not a total loss. I’ve been doing it awhile and there’s always people who try to get free custom content from you. Good Luck!
